legacy.interpretation: Descriptive late improvement only. Training and validation use disjoint cell-hour rows sampled from the pooled development fires. Validation can share fires, overlapping spatial contexts, and fire histories with training, so it evaluates within-fire cell-hour interpolation. The test partition retains its original whole fires, which are absent from training and validation. No verified interpolation threshold or multi-seed grokking claim.
